items.title: Restore deterministic coverage of the reasoned-downgrade branch in dev_memory_preflight_ack
items.context: Either a narrow injectable failure seam on buildPreflightPack, used only by tests, or an extracted pure helper. Production callers must pass no seam and get the real behaviour, the same pattern runtime-environment-checks uses for its probes.

items.title: Prove the seam cannot weaken production and the branch records what it claims
items.context: Test that every production call site passes no override; test that a forced throw plus --reason yields a downgraded acknowledgement carrying that reason; test that without --reason the gate still fails. Do not reintroduce a throwing filesystem shape, since the readers are meant to stay fail-closed.
